newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.29 pct in seesaw trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.29 pct in seesaw trade.

text.p: Brazil's real recovered some ground from Thursday's strong fall in seesaw trade in the commercial foreign exchange market to close at 1.0255 per dollar, up 0.29 percent, dealers said.
The real jumped up and down between 1.0240 and 1.0265 per dollar in speculative trade as dealers eyed the possibility of continued net dollar outflows, which amounted to $87.8 million on Thursday.
But preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a Friday surplus of around $120 million.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real dropped 0.01 percent to end at 1.0294 per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed steady at 1.045 per greenback, traders said.
